name: Greek Gigantes Beans
ingredients: 1½ cups cooked butter beans or gigantes
1 tsp dried oregano and 1 bay leaf
Black pepper, salt and lemon juice
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, oregano, tomato paste, tomatoes and bay leaf and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the beans and ½ cup water and season.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake uncovered for 40 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans are glazed.
Finish with fresh herbs and lemon juice.
note: Traditionally made with dried gigantes beans simmered for hours; canned butter beans are a quick substitute.
